```{r}
#Normal Distribution
pnorm(1.22, 0, 1)
pnorm(1.22, 0, 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
dnorm(0)
pnorm(2.24) - pnorm(-1.58)
dnorm(1.22, 0, 1)
pnorm(2) - pnorm(-2)

pnorm(2, 5, 3) #<=
pnorm(4, 5, 3, lower.tail = FALSE) #> or 1-pnorm(4,5,3)

pnorm(4,5,3) - pnorm(2, 5, 3)

pnorm(7,5,3)
qnorm(0.75, 5,3) # The first argument is an area. It's how we find x point 

pnorm(70, 75, 5)
qnorm(0.8, 75, 5) #or 
qnorm(0.2, 75, 5, lower.tail=F)
qnorm(0.05, 75, 5)
qnorm(0.3, 75, 5) #30 percentile

# mean = 348 sd = 80 #last >= 180
pnorm(180, 348, 80)

# mean = 1.20 st = 0.005 #  1.19 < x < 1.21
pnorm(1.21, 1.20, 0.005) - pnorm(1.19, 1.20, 0.005)



```
